# `bint`

Batch integration with Harmony and/or BBKNN, followed by UMAP/Leiden post-processing

- Wrapper: [`job_batch_integration.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_batch_integration.sh)
- Conda environment: `imc_cellcharter`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.basic_process_batch_integration`

## Inputs

- batch_integration.input_adata_path (fallback: general.anndata_path)
- batch_integration.batch_correction_obs must exist in AnnData.obs for Harmony/BBKNN modes

## Outputs

- batch_integration.output_adata_path (default general.anndata_path)
- general.qc_folder/batch_integration.qc_output_subdir (default QC/BatchIntegration)

## Configuration

- general, batch_integration, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl bint
```
